faq.title: Everything you need to know
faq.subtitle: Clear answers about data privacy, statutory legalities, and platform scope.
faq.q1: Is this legal or tax advice?
faq.a1: No. NiyamAI provides informational compliance health tracking and automated statutory checks. All penalty calculations and risk alerts are indicative guidance. Always consult your qualified Chartered Accountant for legal and tax filings.
faq.q2: Where does my document data go?
faq.a2: Your uploaded licences and invoices are processed securely and audited against rule sets. In demo mode, all data resides in local sample storage and is never shared with third parties.
faq.q3: Which licences are supported in the MVP?
faq.a3: The current MVP pilot supports FSSAI Food Business Operator registration, Municipal Corporation Trade Licences (Bhopal pilot), and Commercial Premises Fire Safety NOCs.
faq.q4: Does the platform work in Hindi?
faq.a4: Yes! NiyamAI supports both Hindi and English with full Devanagari typography support, allowing business owners and staff to review compliance in their preferred language.
faq.cardDesc: Try the interactive demo with real-world Bhopal food retail sample data. No registration or credit card needed.
